title: FLA import: symbol instance AccProps (accessibility name/description, tabIndex, tabEnabled) not decoded
description:
Decoded symbol-instance AccProps from binary CPicSprite/CPicButton trailers (writeAccessibleData layout per flacomdoc): enabled (inverted silent flag), name, description, shortcut, tabIndex, forceSimple. Forwarded via toObjectAccessibility() in flash8-import.ts to SymbolInstance.accessibility. SWF compile already emits tabEnabled/tabIndex DoAction when tabIndex is set.

Tests: pnpm --filter @flash/core run test -- --run src/fla/__tests__/flash8-import.test.ts -t 'task 0937' — 3 passed.
